item.title: NLC India Invites EPC Bids for 250 MW/500 MWh BESS Project in Tamil Nadu with 2-Hour Storage
item.description: NLC India, on behalf of NLC India Renewables Ltd (NIRL), has issued an EPC tender to develop a 250 MW/500 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS), excluding the supply of power transformers. The project will be connected to TANTRANSCO substations located at Annupankulam, Ottapidaram, and Kayathar in Tamil Nadu. NLC India has sought bids for developing the project by January 30, 2026. item.title: Maharashtra: KLK Ventures Secures Order for 1,000 Solar Pumps Under PM-KUSUM
item.description: KLK Ventures Pvt. Ltd. has secured an order for the deployment of 1,000 solar water pumping systems across Maharashtra under the Government of India’s PM-KUSUM scheme. The company informed the media about its latest project win in a statement released today. The project involves the design, supply, and installation of solar pump systems with capacities of 3 HP, 5 HP, and 7.5 HP. item.title: Green Stocks Jan 05- Sustained Pressure Continues For Green Stocks
item.description: Stocks being moved to the F&O segment are usually seen as a positive, as it improves liquidity and visibility. But even this move worked otherwise for leading green stocks Waaree Energies and Premier Energies, as both the solar manufacturing majors suffered significant falls after inclusion. item.title: Japan Launches Its First Commercial Floating Offshore Wind Farm at Goto
item.description: Toda Construction announced that its consortium has commenced commercial operations at the Goto Offshore Wind Farm in Nagasaki Prefecture, marking Japan’s first-ever commercial floating offshore wind project. Officially certified under Japan’s Marine Renewable Energy Sea-Area Utilisation Act, the 16.8 megawatt (MW) facility makes Japan one of the nations advancing floating wind from pilot to full-scale deployment. item.title: Vayona Energy Appoints Pritesh Vinay CEO After Siemens Gamesa Onshore Wind Deal
item.description: Wind turbine original equipment manufacturer (OEM) Vayona Energy, which operates across India and South Asia, has appointed Pritesh Vinay as its new Chief Executive Officer (CEO), effective January 5, 2026. The appointment marks a key milestone in Vayona Energy’s evolution as an independent platform following its acquisition of Siemens Gamesa’s onshore wind business in India and Sri Lanka, the company said in a press release. item.title: IEX Q3 FY’26: From Cheap Power to Tightening Prices as Buyers Shift from DAM to TAM
item.description: The Indian Energy Exchange (IEX), the country’s premier marketplace for electricity, delivered strong double-digit volume growth in Q3 FY’26 even as market conditions shifted sharply by December. The quarter marked a transition from a surplus-driven, low-price environment to a tightening landscape with rising prices and evolving trading strategies. item.title: Gujarat: SECI Issues EPC Tender for Five 160 MVA Transformers, Backing 700 MW Solar Project
item.description: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has issued an EPC tender for the commissioning of five units of 160 MVA, 220/33–33 kV power transformers at RadhaNesda in Gujarat. The power supplied from the transformers under this tender will be utilised for a 700 MW (AC) ground-mounted solar power plant to be established at Radhanesda, Gujarat.
